payload.progression_strategy: Linear load progression on main compound lifts (bench, squat, deadlift, landmine press, hip thrust, bent-over row) per research.json's intermediate-strength finding (heavy 3-6 rep work, 2-3 min rest), double progression on accessories, with a week-6 deload and a week-10 peak.
